preserved_current_summary.notes: Preserved export with the final 9,431/17 corpus counts used by the current TCC. Its config object is empty after a later export update.

configured_summary_snapshot.notes: Versioned snapshot with the same identified/included corpus and explicit execution configuration.

query_generator_snapshot.notes: The canonical query generator was already versioned with 72 queries before the preserved 25/11/2025 report. No complete per-query HTTP request log is preserved in the current repository, so this proves the versioned strategy, not the exact number of network requests issued during collection.

limitations.interpretation: The fixed versioned exports are sufficient to audit the corpus counts, source contributions and temporal distribution. They are not sufficient to reconstruct every HTTP request or to claim that a third party can reproduce the exact historical API responses without re-running the collection against mutable external services.
